Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer on a paid plan. Managing complex projects often means rebuilding the same filters and sort orders again and again. Saved Views removes that repetition by letting you capture the exact combination of filters, grouping, and sorting you rely on, then return to it instantly whenever you need it.

Each user can create and store up to 50 personal views, covering everything from "My overdue tasks" to "This sprint's bugs" to "Blocked items by owner." Once a view works well for you, you can share it with your team so everyone sees the same setup without recreating it themselves, keeping standups, planning sessions, and status checks consistent across the board.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, so there's nothing new to purchase or activate. It's built directly into the lists you already use every day, with no separate settings screen required.

Give it a try on your next project. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
